attchmntText: GACM Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GACM Technologies Limited board approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit was 180.98 lakh for the quarter and 331.81 lakh for the half year. Consolidated net profit was 182.63 lakh for the quarter and 334.73 lakh for the half year. Income from operations was 598.00 lakh for the standalone quarter. Total assets stood at 17,716.65 lakh as of September 30, 2026. Paid-up equity share capital was 17,874.08 lakh. Earnings per share were 0.0128 for the quarter. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026.
